privacy.none: Nothing has been sent to a model for this job.
privacy.provider: {provider}: {calls, plural, one {# request} other {# requests}}, {images, plural, one {# image} other {# images}}, {size}
privacy.localProvider: {provider} runs on this computer, so nothing left it.
